description: Deliver one complete outcome PR stacked on PR A: running agents consume authorized durable history without leaks, duplicate context, lost requests or false delivery success. Include Person-bound execution and execution-private state; bounded refresh before internal model calls; fixed request cursors/canonical dedup; between-request context synchronization and cursor advancement; busy/finalizing request handling; ordered intermediary/final delivery and delayed/asynchronous timeout semantics. Distinguish execution persisted, context synchronized and channel delivery confirmed. Test revoked access, exact runtime/request identity, cumulative deltas, tool-call/result pairing, failed/deferred context application, busy admission and delayed timeout. Detailed beads/internal commits are not separate PRs. Include B-specific docs, validation, explicit UX approval before new E2E, coverage/review and final gate. PR A must remain independently usable.
title: PR B — Live history-aware execution and reliable completion
